ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 1983
PAKISTAN ARMY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Army Act, 1952
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 31st December, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Army (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and section 3 shall, in respect of persons subject to the Pakistan Army
Act, 1952 (XXXIX of 1952), by virtue of sub-clause (ii) of clause (d) of
subsection (1) of section 2 thereof, be deemed to have taken effect on the
twenty-fifth day of September, 1967.

Amendment of section 90, Act XXXIX of 1952

No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 90, Act XXXIX of 1952.-In the Pakistan Army
Act, 1952 (XXXIX of I 952), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section
90, for the full stop at the end a colon shall be substituted and there after
the following proviso shall be added, namely :-
"Provided
that this section shall not apply in a case in which the finding or sentence of
the Court martial has not been confirmed or the proceedings have been annulled
under section 132."
